name: PeoplePicker
tagline: The People Picker lets you choose one or more people - approvers, reviewers, attendees, assignees or team members - by typing part of a name, email, job title…
description: The People Picker lets you choose one or more people - approvers, reviewers, attendees, assignees or team members - by typing part of a name, email, job title, department or office. It shows who each person is (job title, department, office, availability), stops mistakes such as picking the wrong person, too many people or someone who isn't allowed, and can give each person a role and a position in an approval chain.
features: Type-ahead search across name, email, job title
Department and office, department filter, grouped results
Roles per person with required-role rules, approval order
External guest emails with domain rules
Paste from Outlook, min/max limits, undo
Email / name / JSON outputs for canvas Patch
